description: The for rewrite (fz-sc8.17, src/compiler2/source_sugar.rs) refuses uniq: true with a QuotedSourceError naming the form. Elixir's uniq: drops elements already emitted (a set of seen values threaded with the accumulator). Build it in the rewrite with the same hygiene as the other generated variables; oracle fixtures on three paths against elixir; the distiller does not use it.
title: for comprehension uniq: option
